descriptor: An AI-powered system for automating the conversion of email-based requests and Excel reports into structured Power BI solutions.

requirements.statement: The system must analyze email-based requests to identify business objectives, scope, KPIs, filters, calculations, visual requirements, and reporting expectations.
The system must analyze existing Excel reports to identify business objectives, scope, KPIs, filters, calculations, visual requirements, and reporting expectations.
The system must map existing Excel fields to approved current tables and columns.
The system must detect missing, unclear, or conflicting requirements and generate follow-up questions.

The system must recommend data models, relationships, transformations, validation checks, KPI definitions, DAX measures, report pages, slicers, and visual design based on approved requirements and field mappings.
The system must generate a dashboard mockup based on an approved organizational report template.
The system must generate a draft Power BI solution based on an approved organizational report template.
Users must be able to track the complete lifecycle of each request from intake to completion.
The system must use Outlook, Power Automate, SharePoint, AI services, and Power BI to orchestrate the workflow and store inputs and outputs.
The system must maintain a traceable status and approval history for each request.
AI must assist with analysis, recommendations, mapping, documentation, mockups, and draft generation.
AI must not finalize business requirements, approve calculations, or publish a production dashboard without authorized human review and approval.
The system must provide a user interface for stakeholders to review and approve draft Power BI solutions.
The system must validate data before generating the draft Power BI solution.
The system must support the publication of approved Power BI dashboards.
The system must provide notifications to users at key stages of the request lifecycle.
The system must allow users to manually adjust AI-generated recommendations before approval.
The system must support multiple report templates for different organizational needs.

releases.demo: Show end-to-end request intake, analysis, and lifecycle tracking with audit trail.
releases.goal: Establish the basic workflow and trust mechanisms.
releases.name: Initial Setup and Trust Spine

releases.demo: Demonstrate requirement analysis, clarification, and field mapping with AI assistance.
releases.goal: Enable requirement clarification and field mapping.
releases.name: Requirement Clarification and Field Mapping

releases.demo: Show AI-generated design recommendations and dashboard mockups based on templates.
releases.goal: Provide design recommendations and generate dashboard mockups.
releases.name: Design Recommendation and Mockup Generation

releases.demo: Demonstrate draft generation and stakeholder review interface with approval workflow.
releases.goal: Generate draft Power BI solutions and enable stakeholder review.
releases.name: Draft Generation and Stakeholder Review

releases.demo: Show publication of approved dashboards with data validation and notifications.
releases.name: Finalization and Publication

stories.title: Request Intake and Initial Analysis
stories.narrative: As a business analyst, I want to intake requests and perform initial analysis, so that I can understand the scope and objectives.
acceptance: Given a new request, when it is submitted, then it is recorded in the system.
Given an Excel report, when it is uploaded, then the system analyzes it to identify business objectives and scope.
Trust: Given an analysis, when it is completed, then it is logged with a timestamp and analyst ID.
failure_paths: Analysis module fails to extract data
stories.task_guidance: Implement the analysis module to parse Excel reports and extract objectives, scope, KPIs, filters, calculations, visual requirements, and reporting expectations.

stories.title: Lifecycle Tracking Setup
stories.narrative: As a project manager, I want to track the lifecycle of requests, so that I can monitor progress and status.
acceptance: Given a new request, when it is logged, then the system tracks its lifecycle stages.
Given a request update, when it is processed, then the system updates the status and history.
Trust: The system maintains an audit trail of status changes.
stories.task_guidance: Set up SharePoint lists for lifecycle tracking and status updates. Ensure audit logging is enabled.

stories.title: Requirement Clarification
stories.narrative: As a business analyst, I want to clarify unclear requirements, so that I can ensure complete and accurate information.
acceptance: Given an unclear requirement, when it is detected, then the system generates follow-up questions.
Given a complete requirement, when it is reviewed, then no follow-up questions are generated.
Trust: The system logs all clarification interactions in the audit trail.
failure_paths: AI fails to detect unclear requirements
stories.task_guidance: Implement AI-driven requirement analysis and question generation. Log interactions in SharePoint.

stories.title: Field Mapping from Excel
stories.narrative: As a data specialist, I want to map Excel fields to approved tables, so that I can ensure data consistency.
acceptance: Given an Excel report, when it is uploaded, then the system maps fields to approved tables.
Given a field with no mapping, when it is processed, then the system flags it for review.
Trust: The system logs all mapping actions in the audit trail.
stories.task_guidance: Use Power Automate to process Excel uploads and map fields. Log mapping actions in SharePoint.

stories.title: Design Recommendation Generation
stories.narrative: As a business analyst, I want AI to assist in generating design recommendations, so that I can create effective mockups.
acceptance: Given a set of requirements, when AI processes them, then it generates design recommendations.
Given incomplete data, when AI processes it, then it flags missing information.
Trust: Given AI-generated recommendations, when they are created, then they are logged for review.
stories.task_guidance: Integrate AI to assist with analysis, recommendations, mapping, documentation, mockups, and draft generation.

stories.title: Dashboard Mockup Generation
stories.narrative: As a report designer, I want to generate dashboard mockups, so that I can visualize the report layout.
acceptance: Given a design recommendation, when processed, then the system generates a dashboard mockup.
Given a mockup, when reviewed, then it matches the approved template.
Trust: The system logs mockup generation in the audit trail.
stories.task_guidance: Use Power BI to generate mockups based on design recommendations. Log mockup generation in SharePoint.

stories.title: Draft Power BI Solution Generation
stories.narrative: As a report designer, I want to generate draft Power BI solutions, so that I can prepare for stakeholder review.
acceptance: Given a dashboard mockup, when processed, then the system generates a draft Power BI solution.
Given a draft solution, when reviewed, then it aligns with the mockup.
Trust: The system logs draft generation in the audit trail.
failure_paths: Draft does not align with mockup
stories.task_guidance: Use Power BI to generate draft solutions from mockups. Log draft generation in SharePoint.

stories.title: Stakeholder Review Interface
stories.narrative: As a stakeholder, I want to review AI-generated drafts, so that I can approve or request changes before finalization.
acceptance: Given a draft, when it is ready for review, then stakeholders can access it.
Given a draft, when a stakeholder requests changes, then the system logs the request.
Trust: Given a draft, when it is approved, then it is logged with the approver's ID and timestamp.
stories.task_guidance: Develop an interface for stakeholders to review and approve AI-generated drafts, ensuring no finalization without human approval.

stories.title: Data Validation and Finalization
stories.narrative: As a data specialist, I want to validate data before finalizing dashboards, so that I can ensure accuracy.
acceptance: Given a draft solution, when validated, then data accuracy is confirmed.
Given a validation failure, when detected, then the system flags it for correction.
Trust: The system logs all validation actions in the audit trail.
stories.task_guidance: Implement data validation checks using Power BI. Log validation actions in SharePoint.

stories.title: Dashboard Publication
stories.narrative: As a report designer, I want to publish approved dashboards, so that they are available to stakeholders.
acceptance: Given an approved dashboard, when published, then it is available to stakeholders.
Given a publication failure, when detected, then the system alerts the designer.
Trust: The system logs all publication actions in the audit trail.
stories.task_guidance: Use Power BI to publish dashboards. Log publication actions in SharePoint.
